lines: Whoa, hey! {player}! I mean... hi, stranger I have definitely never met before.
{player}: Do I know you?
Not yet! Well... kind of. It's complicated. Time stuff.
I'm Dash. I came here through the pond to fix something. A super important something.
{player}: What are you fixing?
Can't say! If I talk about the future too much it makes time ripples. Little wobbly ones.
{player}: Dash, Rex is running for mayor. What would you want a mayor to do?
A mayor? Rex? My twin brother Rex?
(Dash thinks about it, very fast.)
Okay, okay! A bike lane all the way round the lake! So I can zoom without bumping into anybody.
And tell him if he wins, I'm still not calling him Mayor Rex at breakfast.
{player}: Dash, I found this watch. It's a funny one.
(Dash's eyes go very wide.)
A lost watch! Everyone who lands here brings one. It tracks time the way it worked back home, wherever and whenever home was.
Some of the chosen kids have lost theirs. I'm collecting them. Trying to work out when everyone is from.
{player}: Why?
Can't say! Time ripples. Wobble wobble. But if you find more, bring them to me?
That's {watches_given} of 20. I'll keep it safe, promise.

rotate: Ooh, let me see! Hmm. This one's from a long way away. Or a long time away. Or both!
(Dash holds it up to his ear and listens, very seriously.)
Ticking like it's in a hurry. That's {watches_given} now!
Yes! You're a time detective. {watches_given} down, {watches_left} to go.

lines: Do you feel that? The portal's open! Time's all slow and stretchy right now.
{player}: Is that where you came from?
Ha! Uh... no comment. Time ripples, remember? Wobble wobble.
Out for a ride! Wind in my hair! ...Well, in my hat.
{player}: Where are you going?
Everywhere! Twice! Riding helps me think about... stuff. Future stuff. Shh.
Snack break! Do you know what they have for snacks in the fu-
(Dash claps a hand over his mouth.)
...Crackers. They have crackers. Totally normal crackers.
Sunsets here are the best. Pink and purple and a little bit sparkly.
{player}: Better than the ones where you come from?
Ha! Nice try. No comment.
(Dash yawns a giant yawn.)
Morning, {player}. Bike's ready. Brain's still... loading.
Hey, {player}. If you ever find a watch lying around, a funny-looking one, bring it to me?
People drop them when they land here. Whoosh, plonk. Gone.
{player}: What do they look like?
All different! Everybody counts time their own way. Sundials, hourglasses, beepy ones... Look up high, and down low.
Can't sleep. My brain's going boots-and-cats, boots-and-cats.
{player}: Boots and... cats?
That's how you say house music with your mouth! Try it! Boots-and-cats!
Morning! I already rode around the lake eleven times. Twelve. I lost count.
(Dash leans on his bike. The bike wobbles. Dash wobbles.)
I'm fine!

rotate: Leaning on my bike is my favorite way to stand. Ask anyone. Ask the bike.
The bike has never complained. Not once. Best friend ever.
Psst. Want to know something about the future?

lines: Okay. In the future, there's this giant...
(Dash stops. He squints at the sky.)
...nope. I felt a ripple. Sorry! Ask me again in, like, a hundred years.
Smart. Super smart. You'd be amazing at time travel.

rotate: Untz, untz, untz. That's the beat.
It's always playing in my head. It's a good song. You'd love it. Untz.
